verdict.rationale: Alacritty provides some scriptable startup pieces of its own. Windows can be spawned from scripts via the `alacritty msg create-window` IPC subcommand, and config sets the starting working directory, env vars, window dimensions and startup mode. However, it explicitly omits tabs and splits, leaving layouts to a window manager or multiplexer, and has no session or workspace definition format. Missing for 10: declarative session/workspace definitions, multi-pane or tab layouts, per-window command/directory arguments for create-window documented in evidence, and any hands-on corroboration of a one-command workspace launch.
